crossRefs.note: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,
that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.
Now therefore the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised me, and have taken Uriah the…
After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys…
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…

translations.web: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
translations.bsb: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.
